we have developed a method for label-free differential analysis of peptides in highly-complex mixtures.
we have developed a method for label-free quantitative analysis of peptides using retention time and m / z value as the only criteria for discrimination.

the development of a simple LC-MS method for the differential analysis of complex protein digests.
the development of a novel method for the analysis of peptides and proteins in complex mixtures.
